about: The texture factory's materials (tools/textures/). Each id is the key PixelArt and WoodMaterials ask for (PixelArt.factory). metres: the real size the texture covers, [along u (the grain), across v]; texels follow at texels_per_metre (32) a metre. colours: palette size. ref: [painting, x0, y0, x1, y1], a crop of a concept painting shown to the image model for colour and character (never its pixels). boards: the model's board joints are wiped (members are single boards). lightness, contrast, chroma, hue: the judge's corrections on the tiles in Lab (L*, L*'s spread, a*/b*, a turn of a*/b* in degrees). kind: tile (seamless, repeats on members and props), ground (seamless both ways, laid on the ground from above), sign (one whole board with lettering, not repeated). bold: settings for the bold set only (reduce.py --bold, assets/textures/bold/), over reduce.py's BOLD_GRADE. turn: the painting turned a quarter round before it's cut (its grain painted up the picture). flatten: how much of the painting's broad light is divided out (reduce.py FLATTEN 0.3; 1 all of it).

saloon_wall.what: the inside wall of an old saloon: rough-sawn pine boards stained dark reddish brown by years of lamp smoke, the grain running left to right, saw marks and the odd knot
saloon_wall.about: Painted in the man's hand (docs/briefs/match-the-man.md, 2026-10-16): smooth at 128 a metre, no palette, its own colours (the earlier paintings' lightness, chroma and contrast pushes gutted these). 2026-10-17: lighter and warmer (lightness 1.3, chroma 1.15): the saloon's back was ~8 L* under the warm reference (critic r1, a dim brown void).
